profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit, publicly traded company (ticker: DBX) founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It describes itself as a provider of secure cloud storage, file sharing, and collaboration tools. Its platform supports synced team folders, previews for more than 175 file types, and a product called Dash, which the site describes as a way to save time and organize company content in one place.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings, which provides document summaries, team data handling, and sharing controls. The company's site notes that Dropbox connects with leading AI platforms to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, with built-in AI summaries described as coming soon. An MCP server, listed under the name ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, is also registered, enabling users to search, browse, and read Dropbox files and list folders through external integrations.

Dropbox is a public company with CIK 0001467623 and reported revenue of $2,521,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, as disclosed in a 10-K filing. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
